observations.excerpt: Language Support: The game must have English localization

observations.statement: CrazyGames' audience is aged 13 or more and games must be PEGI 12 compliant.
observations.excerpt: CrazyGames is a website for an audience aged 13 or more. Your game must be PEGI 12 compliant.

observations.statement: For Full Implementation, CrazyGames requires new users to land in gameplay immediately, or within at most 1 click.
observations.excerpt: Games should land new users in gameplay immediately. If this is not feasible given the game specifics, a maximum of 1 click is allowed.

observations.statement: CrazyGames prohibits custom in-game fullscreen buttons.
observations.excerpt: Fullscreen mode is automatically provided by CrazyGames. Custom in-game fullscreen buttons are prohibited, as they can interfere with other features (e.g. monetization).

observations.statement: CrazyGames disallows cross-promotion of external or internal games/platforms.
observations.excerpt: No Cross-Promotion: The game should not include cross-promotions for external or internal games/platforms.

observations.statement: CrazyGames requires game physics to behave consistently across monitor refresh rates such as 144 Hz and 165 Hz.
observations.excerpt: Consistent Physics: The game's physics must perform consistently across different monitor refresh rates (e.g. 144 Hz, 165 Hz)
